scope: Protected word/dword BT/BTS/BTR/BTC and BSF/BSR, exact operands, signed register bit selection and original page repair/retry.

source_basis.note: The source hashes below include newly added files. Frozen KVM binaries were qualified before upstream integration; both rebuilt integration binaries are byte-identical. C projection is separately qualified after integration. LLVM tools were built from the same effective source before its commit. NeverC integration merged independent C++ translation changes and requalified the published compiler.

legacy.choices: Explicit OF/SF/AF/PF for bit tests; CF is computed and ZF preserved. Scans consume an explicit zero-source result/non-ZF image while computing every nonzero index and ZF independently. The independent host observer supplies only these target choices and restores flags; no KVM output supplies defined inputs/results. Register/memory form and actual CS/SS/DS source are preserved in the observation.
legacy.memory: Ordinary paged RAM; signed register indices select a whole operand before final address-size wrapping and segmentation. imm8 masks within the base word. Read/modify/write preparation retains write permission even if the bit does not change. Faults preserve original flags/GPRs/operand bytes; original handlers repair PTEs and retry.
legacy.comparison_boundary: GPRs, flags, CR2, selected operand/stack/frame bytes and successful operand PTE A/D are compared. This is not whole guest RAM identity. Exact faulting-walk A/D remains outside qualification.

native_runtime.boundary: Linux user-mode memory bit strings: CF, complete fixture RAM, signed/extreme indices, unaligned accesses, retained dead effects, SIGSEGV/SIGBUS address/error and marker ordering; no guest event delivery or atomic concurrency claim

compiler.native_contract: i8 CF, pointer and signed i16/i32/i64 index; exact original memory instruction, unknown memory address/extent, byte alignment and retained unused effects. LLVM LocationSize::beforeOrAfterPointer and pruned NeverC invalid LLT express the same unknown extent. Existing atomic register-index forms also use unknown pointer provenance. No atomic concurrency claim for unlocked APIs.
compiler.unused_tool_note: The LLVM-only harness accepted a frozen old NeverC executable as a required CLI argument but never invoked it. It is excluded from active tool claims here.
compiler.mode_boundary: Full LLVM code16/32/64 compiler checks; i386/x64 runtime. NeverC frontend and its direct/combined runtime are x64 only. Code16 compiler bit functions were not executed in KVM.

c_projection.contract: Reject malformed signatures, target widths, nonzero address spaces, weakened memory effects or control attributes. Evaluate base/index once. The native builtin and stock original-instruction branches preserve complete memory faults even for unused carry. Separate test oracles compare all three fixture pages, carry, SIGSEGV/SIGBUS code/address/REG_ERR and marker ordering.

count_definition: Actual repeated executions across compilers, SDKs, optimizations, pass managers and P/E cores; not unique input counts. Earlier failed/focused/pre-integration runs are retained but excluded from the final totals.
retained_diagnostics: first-focus: a word unit expectation incorrectly read a dword including the adjacent selected word; corrected the fixture width, not production execution.
second-focus: the unmapped operand page also held the kernel exception stack; moved the fixture TSS stack before requalifying.
third-focus: a nonflat CS scan observer used DS data; now CS/SS use their actual independent source, preserving the original failed binary/log.
fourth-build-stop: deliberately stopped a NeverD build when its native SDK symlink was found to resolve to the concurrently rebuilding LLVM. Qualification began only after LLVM completed.
neverc-first-build: adapted unknown extent to the pruned backend LLT API. The LLVM backend API is unchanged.

neverc-regression/backend: the old atomic test expected fixed base-object pointer metadata for a signed bit string. It now checks unknown pointer provenance for register-index forms and keeps the fixed-base assertion for other forms.

c-projection/native-first: the test function-pointer typedef did not match LLVM integer/opaque-pointer C carriers. Corrected the oracle signature; the contract checker and production renderer were unchanged.
build-neverd-c-r6.log: a dependency ls-remote lookup failed transiently for simdutf; the ordinary build.py retry succeeded.
The first NeverC atomic push was non-fast-forward rejected after upstream dev advanced. The independent translation changes were merged; no forced update was used.
